estimate.explanation: Dockerfile has 35 lines with 4 layer-creating instructions (RUN/COPY/ADD). Each layer adds build-time memory overhead. Estimated runtime memory: 128 MB, CPU: 160m.

errors.message: Use COPY instead of ADD for files and folders
Use COPY instead of ADD for files and folders

warnings.message: Pin versions in apk add. Instead of `apk add <package>` use `apk add <package>=<version>`

securityIssues.message: Container runs as root: no USER instruction in final stage
securityIssues.suggestion: Create a non-privileged user and switch to it with USER before the entrypoint.
